items.name: Music City Fall 2017
items.information: ![Image description](http://i.imgur.com/5HAdfpD.png) To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue. The event list consists of: Rubik's Cube, 4x4, 6x6, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Fewest Moves, 3x3 One-Handed, 3x3 With Feet, Megaminx, Pyraminx, and 3x3 Multi-blind.

items.name: Neiva SpeedCubing 2017
items.information: COSTO El costo de la inscripción es de $5.000 COP, con este pago puedes participar en uno o más eventos. Para mas información por favor revisar las pestañas de información general, eventos y cronograma. Limite de participantes: 60

items.information: Registration fee is 350php for the first 3 events. Additional 50php will be implemented per extra event thereon. Payment-first basis will be implemented for competitors coming from the Philippines. Refer to the competition tabs for the payment details. Registration fee includes certificate of participation, scoresheets, Competitors IDs and the official competition lanyard.
